method: Exactly two terminal ordinary-input attempts using visible-playtest.mjs and visible UI/screenshots only. No source, old reports, hidden state, debug URLs or route information inspected.

ratings_rationale.gameplay: Readable objective progression and recovery rewards support persistence, but collision confusion and ineffective sustained aim dominated my play. This synthetic session cannot establish human enjoyment.
ratings_rationale.presentation: Strong coherent rain, wet light, cyan/amber palette, typography and title/end screens. Geometry, characters and weapon look visibly simple and repeated.
ratings_rationale.usability: Map and distance indicators help, but I repeatedly pushed into machinery and cover without knowing why apparently open paths failed. Recovery reach required several corrections under fire.
ratings_rationale.readability: Large vitals, ammo and objective are clear; numerous simultaneous lower-left guidance, compass, minimap and combat indicators compete. World markers sometimes landed away from the receiver I needed.
ratings_rationale.AAA_readiness: Promising vertical slice, but this evidence does not support AAA certification; navigation friction, combat clarity and asset detail need substantial work.

attempts.later_interactions: Died while moving toward East Archive. No Elian, Custodian or upload interaction reached.
attempts.aiming: Opening centered rifle fire killed induction Warden with critical feedback. Later ADS turn/fire at patrol and sentinel spent ammunition without an elimination; last close Warden burst produced the second kill.
attempts.obstructions_and_corrections: Initial forward movement and jump stalled at low cover (distance stayed 42 m); strafed left then advanced. Later walked into archive wall, corrected right toward visible receiver; E at 5.8 m failed, forward step then E recovered Mara. Heart E at 5.3 m failed; right step then E recovered Sera.

attempts.later_interactions: Reached Custodian phase, saw three coils at 100%, shutters armored/open-window guidance, moved within about 5.3 m and fired. No observed coil damage; last captured coil percentages remained 100%. Never released uplink or uploaded.
attempts.aiming: Opening rifle burst killed guard. Multiple ADS adjustments overshot or aimed into cover, with little effective damage. I saw sentinel charging but did not successfully eliminate it. Final fire toward Custodian did not demonstrate damage before death.
attempts.obstructions_and_corrections: East machinery blocked several movement batches (47 m objective distance barely changed); backed out and strafed, later dash/jump finally opened yard access. Mara and Sera needed closer steps after failed E holds. Explicit outside-reach meter helped correct Sera and Elian approach; recovered Elian after forward/right correction. Brown wall blocked Custodian approach; moved around side and turned to reacquire it.

noticed_and_used: M facility map: inspected map legend and west archive placement after getting blocked. It helped choose a left-side correction, although not precise collision handling.
Hold E and receiver distance: successfully used on all three receivers across the attempts.
Move closer / outside reach / floor ring: actually used to make short corrections and recover Sera and Elian in attempt 2.
Shift break nearby charges: used multiple times; terminal UI confirms one phase evade in attempt 2.
Reload R: used successfully; ammo visibly restored.
seen_without_demonstrated_benefit: C crouch near cover: saw text, did not crouch.
Interceptors track movement / change direction after charge: saw text, did not demonstrate intentional timed counterplay.
Custodian armored/open-window and chip guidance: saw and attempted fire, no coil damage observed.
Upload inside marked deck and outside-decay explanation on menu/HUD: read but never reached upload.
guidance.trace: Attempted held Tab capture. No clear route line was visible in that photograph; later ground chevrons appeared in ordinary captures, but my use did not reliably prevent collision.

concrete_corrections: Make collision boundaries and usable openings more visually explicit, especially near east machinery and low cover.
Keep route markers on visibly traversable ground and communicate blocked movement sooner.
Improve hit/miss and armor feedback so sustained fire explains failure more clearly.
Show receiver reach direction/ring clearly before E is held; repeated near-but-outside holds cost health.
Reduce competing instructional overlays during combat while retaining essential vitals and threat state.
limitations: Paused synthetic screenshot play and software WebGL do not establish human enjoyment, audio quality, or hardware performance.
Poor aim and movement are reviewer limitations as well as usability evidence; low accuracy is not proof weapons are broken.
